description: Ohio State — strong OH in-state applicant, RD (residency-neutral state → NO boost)
rationale: Burden-of-proof sentinel. OSU's own CDS shows in-state 57.3% ≈ out-of-state 59.0% — residency is NOT priced. OH carries no entry in STATE_IN_STATE_OVER_OVERALL, so the new DEFAULT 1.0 (neutral) applies: a strong applicant's prediction is driven by the overall anchor × stats, with NO in-state boost. Range [0.6, 0.92] is anchor-tolerant on purpose — the stored OSU overall differs between environments (local 50.8% post-#313 audit vs the CI closure-overlay's older ~60.6%), giving ~0.71 vs ~0.85; both are 'neutral × strong-stats'. A spurious in-state boost (e.g. the old flat 1.2×) would clamp toward ~0.98 and be caught above 0.92.
